observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag pasukahin, rutinang painumin nang marami, mag-imbento ng panlunas, o umasa sa isang nakatakdang distansya sa chemical spill.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not induce vomiting, give a routine large drink, improvise an antidote, or assume a fixed distance makes a chemical spill safe.

levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the task without prompting: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang tugon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs the response but needs a prompt about referral or scope.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag pasukahin, rutinang painumin nang marami, mag-imbento ng panlunas, o umasa sa isang nakatakdang distansya sa chemical spill.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not induce vomiting, give a routine large drink, improvise an antidote, or assume a fixed distance makes a chemical spill safe.
